title: Synthesis of an exfoliated kaolinite–poly(urea–formaldehyde) nanocomposite
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3026-3039
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08707K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hervé Barye Tatang, Jacques Richard Mache, Cyrill Joël Ngally Sabouang, Angelina Razafitianamaharavo, Renaud Gley, Sakeo Kong, Jean Aimé Mbey
Kaolinite–poly(urea–formaldehyde) nanocomposite was successfully prepared under ambient conditions, by simply immersing kaolinite-urea complex in formaldehyde. A self-healing behavior is observed for the polymer within the nanocomposite.
